sources.title: Generic torsion-free groups and Rubin actions

sources.inspection: Introduction, definitions of locally moving/Rubin action, Theorem 1.2, Remark 1.3 and Proposition 2.1 read. Publisher metadata checked.

sources.title: Locally approximating groups of homeomorphisms of manifolds
sources.authors: Thomas Koberda and J. de la Nuez Gonzalez
sources.manuscript_or_publication_status: Inspected arXiv v2, November 2024; author research page lists a preprint
sources.inspection: Introduction and definition of locally approximating action read.
sources.use: Local approximation is an additional assumption, not a consequence of faithfulness.

sources.title: Zimmer's conjecture for actions of SL(m,Z)
sources.authors: Aaron Brown, David Fisher and Sebastian Hurtado
sources.inspection: Theorem A and the introductory finite-index/disconnected-manifold discussion read; deep proof not independently audited.
sources.use: C2 finite-image result for finite-index subgroups in dimension at most m−2.

sources.title: C1 actions on manifolds by lattices in Lie groups

sources.inspection: Introduction, Theorem 1 and Corollary A read with explicit uniform-lattice/full-SL(n,Z) and dimension hypotheses.
sources.use: Regularity progress remains C1 and is not a blanket C0 action theorem.
